answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Every claim climbs the jade of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vault re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a direct imperative tone, zero filler words, cryptographic jargon register, it stays short. The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
